title: How Moving the Charger Ends a Godly Man's Late-Night Scroll
caption:
A godly man's phone sleeps in the kitchen. Not his room. One small habit before bed, that's the whole war.

Willpower loses to a lit screen at 11 PM every time. Don't fight it in your room. Fight it in the kitchen.

Win the first hour before the feed does. Name what you're actually reaching for before you reach. Let the night end quiet.

The kitchen charger is a small war. Small wars are still wars.

#christianmen #digitaldiscipline #godlymanhood #selfcontrol #biblicalmanhood
